Name: (AT) Quilt replacer for Blue Pinstriped Bed
Author: LynnyoftheValley
Description: A retexture mod using Alternative Textures to add a quilt to the blue pinstriped bed for those that like the bed but don't love the blue and would prefer a cozier option. There is an option to have pink sheets and patterned pillows for those that want the extra detail. You can pick and choose which variation you want they all come included. There is also just single variations if you don't want extra textures clogging up the menu.

Downloads.Description: This file just has the original file with both the pillows and sheet also recolored
